identification: Two unmarked Victorian-to-early 20th century English style cast iron kettles (one small with copper lid and wooden handle, one with brass handle and wooden grip) and a lidded cast iron camp oven with copper-toned lid and lid lifter. Sooty, rust inside oven. Makers unseen.

chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'cast iron kettle copper lid' sold; 'cast iron camp oven lid' sold; 'T&C Clark kettle' sold; 'Kenrick kettle' sold. Also Gumtree/Facebook asking prices and LiveAuctioneers 'cast iron camp oven' for resale ranges. Common items; expect roughly $30-100 per piece resale, shipping heavy so local pickup limits buyers.
viewing_check: Turn kettles over and check the base and under the lid for maker marks (Clark, Kenrick, Mertons, Rd numbers, size number). Check kettles for cracks, holes or leaks, and the oven lid for a fit and a cracked rim; note oven size and any maker casting on the base.
